question: do the committed instrument test suites detect faults, or do they only restate the author assumptions
method: semantic mutations were applied one at a time to each instrument module, the paired suite was run, the module was restored, and restoration was verified by digest

survivors.mutation: accept an episode with a zero dimension score
count repeated tokens so carry-through can exceed one
treat a fired probe as admissible

most_severe_survivor: release_sandbox.py returned admissible for a report with a fired probe and every test still passed, so the entire fail-closed admission gate could be neutralised silently

checks: a dimension scored zero is not fatal-error-free
a redline blocks fatal-error-free even with positive dimensions
carry-through ratio stays within zero and one
a report with any fired probe is inadmissible
a report with no fired probe is admissible

defect_found_in_the_test_harness: the scoring suite computed its pass tally before the newly added checks ran, so it reported 14 of 18 while every check passed; the tally is now computed after all checks
claim_scope: test adequacy evidence only; catching these mutations does not show the instruments are correct
